scoring_justification: The K values are fixed deterministic quantities from Table I; a result-level compare with absolute tolerance correctly verifies the reproduction. Recomputing from the raw parameter scan would require a complex algorithm to detect bicritical/tricritical points, which is not feasible for a lightweight checker.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold K values for multicritical points C1–C8 from paper Table I.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I: The K Values of Some Bicritical and Tricritical Points.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's Table I values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published reference values of the paper; they are not fabricated.

outputs.description: K values of the bicritical/tricritical points C1–C8. Each object contains the point id and its K-coordinate, compared against the hidden gold values from Table I of the source paper within an absolute tolerance of 0.005.
